# phalcon-validation — Complete API & Specification

> High-performance, expressive PHP Data Validation and Sanitization library for Phalcon Framework v5 and v6, inspired by GUMP.

## Table of Contents
1. Package Identity & Architecture
2. Core APIs & Usage Styles
3. File Upload Suite (Filters & Validators)
4. Complete 17 Built-in Data Filters (Sanitizers)
5. Complete 80+ Built-in Validation Rules
6. Nested Arrays & Wildcard Engine
7. Phalcon Integration (DI Container, MVC Model ORM, Native C-Bridge)
8. Custom Extensions (Validators & Filters)

---

## 1. Package Identity & Architecture

- **Composer Package:** `phatnt93/phalcon-validation`
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/phatnt93/phalcon-validation
- **PHP Requirements:** PHP ^8.1 || ^8.2 || ^8.3 || ^8.4 (100% strict typing)
- **Framework Support:** Phalcon Framework v5 (`ext-phalcon` 5.x) and v6 (`ext-phalcon` 6.x)
- **License:** MIT

### Dual-Path Execution Architecture
1. **Engine Path (Default):** Executes via `RuleEngine` and `FilterEngine`. Handles multidimensional dot notation, wildcard arrays (`items.*.price`), automatic file upload normalization, and dual-language localization (`en`, `vi`).
2. **Native C-Bridge Path:** Activated via `PhalconValidationAdapter::build($rules)`. Translates rule strings directly into a native C-extension `Phalcon\Filter\Validation` instance without dropping custom or extended rules (bridged safely via Phalcon Callback validator). Pass/fail results match `Validator::is_valid()` for the same rules and data: only 14 rules with identical native semantics use C-validators (`required`, `valid_email`, `valid_url`, `valid_ip*`, `*_len`, `alpha`, `equalsfield`, `date,<format>`, `required_file`), empty values (`''`, `null`, `[]`) skip non-presence rules, and messages come from the global Translator. Unlike Path 1 it is not fail-fast: one field can return several messages.

---

## 2. Core APIs & Usage Styles

### Style A: One-Liner Shorthand (GUMP Style)
```php
use PhalconValidation\PhalconValidation;

$cleanData = PhalconValidation::run($_POST, [
    'username' => 'required|alpha_numeric|between_len,3;20',
    'email'    => 'required|valid_email',
], [
    'username' => 'trim|lower_case',
    'email'    => 'trim|lower_case|sanitize_email',
]);

if ($cleanData === false) {
    $errors = PhalconValidation::get_errors_array();
    // ['username' => '...', 'email' => '...']
}
```

### Style B: Fluent Instance API
```php
use PhalconValidation\Validator;

$validator = new Validator('en'); // or 'vi' for Vietnamese

$result = $validator->validateData($data, $rules, $filters);

if ($result->isValid()) {
    $cleanData = $result->getData();
} else {
    $errors = $result->getErrorsArray();
    $rawList = $result->getErrors();
    $html = $result->getReadableErrors(true);
}
```

### Style C: Boolean Checker
```php
use PhalconValidation\Validator;

$isValid = Validator::is_valid($data, [
    'email' => 'required|valid_email',
    'age'   => 'required|integer|min_numeric,18',
]);

if ($isValid !== true) {
    // $isValid contains array of error messages
}
```

### Localization (i18n)
- Shipped locales: `en` (default and fallback), `vi`. Constants: `Translator::DEFAULT_LOCALE`, `Translator::SUPPORTED_LOCALES`.
- Locale codes are normalized (`EN` → `en`, `en-us` → `en_US`). Malformed codes throw `PhalconValidation\Exceptions\InvalidLocaleException`.
- Lookup order: field-specific custom message → rule custom message → current locale → base language (`vi` for `vi_VN`) → `en` → generic message.
- Placeholders: `{field}`, `{param}`, `{param:0}`, `{param:1}`.

```php
use PhalconValidation\Validator;

$validator = new Validator('vi');          // or ->setLocale('vi_VN')
$validator->setFieldNames(['email' => 'Địa chỉ email']);

// Add or override messages for any locale without modifying the library
$validator->addTranslations('fr', ['required' => 'Le champ {field} est obligatoire.']);
$validator->setLocale('fr');
```

---

## 3. File Upload Suite (Filters & Validators)

### 3.1. Filter: `normalize_files` (alias: `normalize_file`)
Transforms PHP's awkward multi-file `$_FILES` structure into a clean, sequential list of file arrays:
```php
$filters = ['photos' => 'normalize_files'];
// Result in $cleanData['photos']:
// [
//     0 => ['name' => 'p1.jpg', 'type' => 'image/jpeg', 'tmp_name' => '/tmp/1', 'error' => 0, 'size' => 1024, 'full_path' => 'p1.jpg'],
//     1 => ['name' => 'p2.png', 'type' => 'image/png',  'tmp_name' => '/tmp/2', 'error' => 0, 'size' => 2048, 'full_path' => 'p2.png'],
// ]
```

### 3.2. File Validation Rules
- **`required_file`**: File must be uploaded without errors (`UPLOAD_ERR_OK`, size > 0, non-empty filename).
- **`extension,ext1;ext2`**: File extension must be in allowed list (`png;jpg;pdf`).
- **`mimetype,type1;type2`** (alias: `mime_type`): Real binary MIME type inspected via `finfo_file` on disk (prevents spoofing).
- **`max_file_size,limit`**: Max file size (`2mb`, `500kb`, `1048576`).
- **`min_file_size,limit`**: Min file size (`10kb`, `1024`).

### 3.3. Polymorphic Input Support
Every file validator accepts:
1. Single native file array (`$_FILES['avatar']`).
2. Multiple native PHP file array (`$_FILES['photos']`).
3. Normalized file list array.
4. Phalcon File object (`Phalcon\Http\Request\File`).
5. Direct string path on disk.

---

## 4. Complete 17 Built-in Data Filters (Sanitizers)

1. **`trim`**: Strip whitespace from start/end (Phalcon native C).
2. **`sanitize_string`**: Remove script tags and dangerous HTML (XSS prevention).
3. **`sanitize_email`**: Remove illegal email characters (Phalcon native C).
4. **`sanitize_numbers`**: Keep only digits `0-9`, `+` and `-`.
5. **`sanitize_floats`**: Keep only digits, signs, and decimal point `.`.
6. **`boolean`**: Cast `['1', 1, 'true', true, 'yes', 'on']` to boolean `true`, else `false`.
7. **`basic_tags`**: Keep safe HTML tags (`<b>`, `<i>`, `<p>`), strip scripts.
8. **`whole_number`**: Cast to integer via `intval()` (preserves negative numbers).
9. **`ms_word_characters`**: Normalize MS Word smart quotes and dashes to web-safe characters.
10. **`lower_case`**: Convert to lowercase UTF-8 (Phalcon native C).
11. **`upper_case`**: Convert to uppercase UTF-8 (Phalcon native C).
12. **`slug`**: Convert to URL slug (supports Vietnamese accents).
13. **`urlencode`**: URL-encode string characters.
14. **`htmlencode`**: Convert HTML characters to HTML entities.
15. **`rmpunctuation`**: Strip all punctuation characters from string.
16. **`noise_words`**: Strip stop-words from text.
17. **`normalize_files`** (alias: `normalize_file`): Normalize native `$_FILES` arrays into clean list.

---

## 5. Complete 80+ Built-in Validation Rules

### 5.1. Presence
- `required`: Must be present, not null, not empty string, not empty array.
- `required_file`: Must be valid uploaded file without error code.

### 5.2. Strings & Length
- `min_len,n`: String length >= n.
- `max_len,n`: String length <= n.
- `exact_len,n`: String length == n.
- `between_len,min;max`: String length inclusive between min and max.
- `word_count,min,v1,max,v2`: Word count within specified range.

### 5.3. Characters & Formatting
- `alpha`: Letters only (Unicode; native `Alpha` in `PhalconValidationAdapter::build()`).
- `alpha_numeric`: Letters (Unicode) and digits only.
- `alpha_numeric_space`: Letters, digits, and spaces.
- `alpha_numeric_dash`: Letters, digits, dashes, and underscores.
- `alpha_dash`: Letters, dashes, and underscores.
- `alpha_space`: Letters and spaces only.
- `camel_case`: Valid camelCase string.
- `snake_case`: Valid snake_case string.
- `url_slug`: Valid URL slug format (`foo-bar-123`).

### 5.4. Numbers & Math
- `numeric`: Numeric value (`is_numeric`).
- `integer`: Integer value (signed).
- `float`: Floating point number.
- `boolean`: Boolean representation.
- `min_numeric,n`: Numeric value >= n.
- `max_numeric,n`: Numeric value <= n.
- `between_numeric,min;max`: Number between min and max inclusive.
- `even`: Even integer.
- `odd`: Odd integer.
- `prime`: Prime integer number.
- `starts,prefix`: String starts with given prefix.

### 5.5. Comparison & Regex
- `equalsfield,targetField`: Value must equal target field value.
- `regex,/pattern/`: Matches regular expression (`preg_match`).

### 5.6. Network & Web
- `valid_email`: RFC-compliant email address (native C validator in `PhalconValidationAdapter::build()`).
- `valid_url`: Valid URL format (native C validator in `PhalconValidationAdapter::build()`).
- `url_exists,[allow_private]`: http(s) URL answers a HEAD request with 2xx/3xx (no redirects, 5 s timeout). Hosts resolving to private/reserved IPs are rejected unless `allow_private` is given (SSRF protection). Sends a network request per value.
- `valid_ip`: Valid IP address (native C validator in `PhalconValidationAdapter::build()`).
- `valid_ipv4`: Valid IPv4 address.
- `valid_ipv6`: Valid IPv6 address.
- `mac_address`: Valid MAC address.
- `domain_name`: Valid domain name format.
- `port_number`: Integer between 1 and 65535.
- `social_handle`: Valid social media handle.
- `valid_name`: Valid human personal name.

### 5.7. Date & Time
- `date,[format]`: Valid calendar date. Default accepts ISO 8601 only (`Y-m-d`, `Y-m-d H:i[:s]`, `Y-m-d\TH:i[:s]` with optional `+07:00`/`Z`); relative strings like `now` are rejected. With a format the value must match it exactly.
- `date_range,start;end`: Date falls within inclusive range.
- `past_date`: Date strictly in the past.
- `future_date`: Date strictly in the future.
- `business_day`: Date falls on Monday-Friday.
- `valid_time`: Valid 24h or 12h time string.
- `min_age,years`: Minimum age in years calculated from date of birth.

### 5.8. Geo & ISO
- `latitude`: Valid latitude between -90 and 90.
- `longitude`: Valid longitude between -180 and 180.
- `coordinates`: Lat,Long coordinate pair.
- `postal_code`: Valid postal code format.
- `street_address`: Valid street address string.
- `country_code`: Valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 / alpha-3 code.
- `currency_code`: Valid ISO 4217 currency code.
- `language_code`: Valid ISO 639-1 / 639-2 code.
- `timezone`: Valid PHP timezone identifier.

### 5.9. Security & Identification
- `valid_cc`: Valid credit card number (Luhn algorithm).
- `iban`: Valid International Bank Account Number.
- `uuid`: Valid UUID format.
- `guidv4`: Valid Version 4 GUID/UUID.
- `jwt_token`: Valid JSON Web Token format.
- `hash,algo`: Valid hash string matching algorithm length.
- `base64`: Valid Base64-encoded string.
- `strong_password`: Strong password (8+ chars, upper, lower, digit, special).
- `nosqlinjection`: Checks against SQL injection keywords.
- `noxss`: Checks against cross-site scripting constructs.
- `phone_number`: Valid international/national phone number.

### 5.10. Content & Arrays
- `contains,val`: Value contains substring or array contains item.
- `contains_list,a;b`: Value contains one of the items.
- `doesnt_contain_list,a;b`: Value does not contain any of the items.
- `valid_json_string`: Valid JSON string syntax.
- `valid_array_size_equal,n`: Array has exactly n elements.
- `valid_array_size_greater,n`: Array has at least n elements.
- `valid_array_size_lesser,n`: Array has at most n elements.

### 5.11. File Uploads
- `extension,ext1;ext2`: Allowed extensions (`pdf;docx;png;jpg`).
- `mimetype,type1;type2`: Allowed MIME types via finfo (`image/png;image/jpeg`).
- `max_file_size,limit`: Max file size (`2mb`, `500kb`, bytes).
- `min_file_size,limit`: Min file size (`10kb`, bytes).

### 5.12. Phalcon Database ORM
- `unique,ModelClass,column,[ignoreCol],[ignoreVal]`: Database uniqueness check.
- `exists,ModelClass,column`: Database existence check.

---

## 6. Nested Arrays & Wildcard Engine
```php
$data = [
    'company' => ['name' => 'Acme Corp'],
    'users'   => [
        ['name' => 'John', 'email' => 'john@acme.com', 'roles' => ['admin', 'billing']],
        ['name' => 'Jane', 'email' => 'jane@acme.com', 'roles' => ['developer']],
    ],
];

$rules = [
    'company.name'    => 'required|min_len,2',
    'users.*.name'    => 'required|valid_name',
    'users.*.email'   => 'required|valid_email',
    'users.*.roles.*' => 'required|alpha',
];
```

---

## 7. Phalcon Integration

### Dependency Injection (DI) Service Provider
```php
use Phalcon\Di\FactoryDefault;
use PhalconValidation\Adapters\Phalcon\ValidationServiceProvider;

$di = new FactoryDefault();
$di->register(new ValidationServiceProvider('validator'));

// Inside Controller:
$clean = $this->validator->run($this->request->getPost(), $rules, $filters);
```

### Native Phalcon C-Extension Bridge
```php
use PhalconValidation\Adapters\Phalcon\PhalconValidationAdapter;

$nativeValidation = PhalconValidationAdapter::build([
    'email'    => 'required|valid_email',
    'password' => 'required|strong_password',
]);

$messages = $nativeValidation->validate($_POST);
```
